{{Quote|These gave as good as they got, and 'cold' and 'hot' wars alternated for a thousand years&mdash;while the Republic flagellated itself with inquisitions&mdash;until Pius Dea rule met its end in that famous encounter which hardly needs retelling here.|Gabrel Treon, ''Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes''|<ref name="TTSP">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref>}}
The '''Seventh Alsakan Conflict''', also known as the '''Renunciation''' or the '''Pius Dea Civil War''', was one of several [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|conflicts]] between the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and their respective allies. The seventh was a war between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;under the control of the [[Pius Dea]] religious group&mdash;and their enemies, including the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Alsakan, and many [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that had been persecuted by the Pius Dea cult. The conflict resulted in an Alsakani&ndash;[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] victory, with the removal of the Pius Dea from power and replacement of the Pius Dea leader [[Contispex XIX]] with Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Biel Ductavis]] as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]].

==Prelude==
The [[Pius Dea]] was a religious cult that had controlled the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] ever since the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex I]] was elected [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] in [[11,987 BBY]]. His descendants formed the [[Contispex dynasty]], cementing their control of the Republic for over a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. During their reign&mdash;a [[Time/Legends|time]] later known as the [[Pius Dea Era]]&mdash;the Pius Dea launched a series of thirty-four [[Pius Dea Crusades|crusades]] against [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and suspected alien sympathizers.<ref name="TEGtW" />

The cult's [[Humanocentrism|humanocentric]] views and their aggressive actions against non-Humans angered many alien species, driving groups such as the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], [[Herglic/Legends|Herglics]], [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], and the [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] to oppose their rule. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] had long split with the Pius Dea&ndash;controlled Republic, having [[Recusal|recused]] themselves to their [[Jedi academy|academy]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] in [[11,933 BBY]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==The conflict==
[[File:Coruscant_SWCT.png|thumb|left|250px|Coruscant, the capital of the Pius Dea&ndash;controlled Republic]]
Around [[10,967 BBY]], the peaceful Caamasi finally convinced the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to end their Recusal and act against the Pius Dea. The Caamasi also convinced the inhabitants of the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] and their allies to join the fight, and began making alliances with alien species that had been persecuted by the Pius Dea. Over the next few [[Standard month/Legends|months]], the two groups secretly instigated a religious revolution amongst the Pius Dea. Unknowingly influenced by the Jedi, many believers joined the movement and renounced the traditional Pius Dea faith in favor of one more favorable to alien species. Those Pius Dea who followed that new faith secretly called themselves the [[Renunciates]], gathering new members throughout the Republic.<ref name="TEGtW" />

The schism sparked a brutal civil war between the Renunciates and those who remained loyal to their faith&mdash;known as the [[Pius Dea|Faithful]]. Renunciates and Faithful battled across the Republic, ravaging [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depots]], [[Generation ship/Legends|generation ships]], government offices, and a myriad of other locations. Alsakani forces attacked Pius Dea fortresses at [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], [[Cyrillia/Legends|Cyrillia]], [[Ixtlar/Legends|Ixtlar]], [[Ord Mirit]], and [[Carida/Legends|Ord Carida]], supported by the Jedi Order and the combined forces of their allies&mdash;primarily the Duros, Herglics, and the Hutts.<ref name="TEGtW" /> The Republic's [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit]] also saw action against Pius Dea forces on Ord Carida.<ref name="AC4">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref>

The conflict soon exploded into all-out war, as the Pius Dea&ndash;led Republic began attacking the Renunciates and the Jedi-led alliance. However, much of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] decided to defect from the Republic, joining the Jedi and Alsakani against the religious fanatics. While the Pius Dea were greatly weakened by the defection, they still had an entire [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[cathedral ship]]s to rely upon, and continued to wage war against those they saw as impure.<ref name="TEGtW" />

It was not until a [[10,966 BBY|year later]] that the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] (BoSS) decided to make their move. Coordinating with the Renunciates and the alliance, the BoSS secretly seeded Pius Dea's fleet of cathedral [[Starship/Legends|ships]] with rogue [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]] codes. The Order and its allies gathered their forces at the planet [[Uquine/Legends|Uquine]], baiting the Faithful into attacking the Renunciate fleet there. Just before the Pius Dea's fleet jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the BoSS sent a signal to every ship in the fleet that activated the implanted code.<ref name="TEGtW" />

More than half of the fleet disappeared and was lost in hyperspace. Many of those missing cathedral ships found themselves stranded in deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]], with their navicomputers wiped clean and their [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] and communications systems rendered useless. Those aboard would be unable to return, and would eventually [[Death/Legends|die]] from lack of supplies. The remaining ships arrived at Uquine to find themselves [[Battle of Uquine|under attack]] by the combined forces of the Renunciates and the Jedi-led alliance.<ref name="TEGtW" />

A strike team of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] boarded the Pius Dea [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Flame of Sinthara]]'' and captured Supreme Chancellor [[Contispex XIX]], ending the Pius Dea's rule of the Republic. Contispex was taken to the planet [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]], where he was found guilty of crimes against [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and imprisoned for the rest of his life. Without their leader, the Pius Dea faith crumbled after their defeat at Uquine. Every single member of the faith was removed from office, and Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Biel Ductavis]] succeeded Contispex XIX as Supreme Chancellor.<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Aftermath==
The Seventh Alsakan Conflict ended a millennium of widespread fear and state-sponsored persecution, ushering in the [[Ductavis Era]] of rebuilding and restoration. The Pius Dea faith died out not long after the end of the conflict, as the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] turned on them in revenge for the millennia of persecution that they had caused.<ref name="TEGtW" /> The faith's humanocentric views, however, would remain just below the surface of society&mdash;by the fall of the Republic, the idea of [[High Human Culture/Legends|Human High Culture]] was once more widely accepted in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] used the humanocentric attitude of the primarily-Human Core to help cement his control over the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] millennia later in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Holonet">{{InsiderCite|70|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:9:04}}</ref> Despite the fact that Alsakan had aided the Jedi in removing the Pius Dea from power, this would not prevent the planet from rebelling against Coruscant and the Republic later on. Alsakan and its allies would continue attempting to usurp Coruscant as the Republic capital in a further ten conflicts, with the [[Seventeenth Alsakan Conflict|final conflict]] ending almost [[3017 BBY|eight thousand years]] later.<ref name="TEGtW" />

Biel Ductavis was one of the earliest Jedi to assume the post of Supreme Chancellor, and he began a trend of Jedi assuming power in times of turmoil. During the second half of the [[New Sith Wars]], each leader of the Jedi Order also served as Supreme Chancellor&mdash;a practice that ended with the election of Supreme Chancellor [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]] and the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]].<ref name="Influx">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/knighterrant_influx/index.html|text=''Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx''|int=Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Seventh Alsakan Conflict was first indirectly mentioned in the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive history article ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'', as the "famous encounter" that ended the Pius Dea Era.<ref name="TTSP" /> It was later expanded upon in the [[2012]] [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|reference guide]] ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', along with the rest of the Pius Dea era and the Pius Dea crusades.<ref name="TEGtW" />
